title: Samsung Connects Galaxy Gallery with Google Storage

sources.name: Samsung Global Newsroom
sources.title: Samsung Gallery Makes It Easier To Access Photos and Videos Across Galaxy Devices

paragraphs.en: In a November 10 announcement,
paragraphs.zh: 在11月10日的公告中，

paragraphs.en: Samsung described a Gallery service
paragraphs.zh: 三星介紹了一項相簿服務，

paragraphs.en: that connects its photo app with Google storage.
paragraphs.zh: 將自家的相片應用程式與Google儲存空間連結。

paragraphs.en: The service initially supports selected phones and tablets
paragraphs.zh: 這項服務初期支援部分手機和平板電腦，

paragraphs.en: running One UI 9,
paragraphs.zh: 且須搭載One UI 9，

paragraphs.en: and availability varies by market.
paragraphs.zh: 實際供應情況則因市場而異。

paragraphs.en: The collaboration brings cloud access directly
paragraphs.zh: 這項合作將雲端存取功能直接

paragraphs.en: into Samsung's existing photo app,
paragraphs.zh: 整合進三星既有的相片應用程式，

paragraphs.en: so users can browse their synchronized collection
paragraphs.zh: 讓使用者可以瀏覽已同步的相片集，

paragraphs.en: in a familiar interface.
paragraphs.zh: 並使用熟悉的操作介面。

paragraphs.en: To view photos across supported devices,
paragraphs.zh: 若要跨支援的裝置瀏覽相片，

paragraphs.en: users need the same Samsung and Google accounts
paragraphs.zh: 使用者必須登入相同的三星與Google帳戶，

paragraphs.en: and must enable synchronization on each device.
paragraphs.zh: 並在各裝置上開啟同步功能。

paragraphs.en: A new device can display previews
paragraphs.zh: 新裝置可以顯示預覽，

paragraphs.en: while original files remain online.
paragraphs.zh: 而原始檔案仍保留在雲端。

paragraphs.en: Users can download originals when needed.
paragraphs.zh: 使用者可以在需要時下載原始檔。

paragraphs.en: For example, a picture taken on a Galaxy phone
paragraphs.zh: 例如，用Galaxy手機拍下的相片，

paragraphs.en: can later be viewed in Gallery on a tablet
paragraphs.zh: 之後便能在平板電腦的相簿中瀏覽，

paragraphs.en: with the required accounts and settings.
paragraphs.zh: 前提是使用所需的帳戶與設定。

paragraphs.en: Samsung also offers a feature
paragraphs.zh: 三星也提供一項功能，

paragraphs.en: that removes synchronized originals from a device
paragraphs.zh: 可從裝置移除已同步的原始檔案，

paragraphs.en: while keeping small preview images visible.
paragraphs.zh: 同時繼續顯示小型預覽圖。

paragraphs.en: However, deleting a synchronized item in Gallery
paragraphs.zh: 不過，若在相簿中刪除已同步的項目，

paragraphs.en: also removes it from linked Google storage
paragraphs.zh: 也會將它從連結的Google儲存空間中移除，

paragraphs.en: and other connected Galaxy devices.
paragraphs.zh: 其他已連結的Galaxy裝置也會移除該項目。

paragraphs.en: There is another important limit.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，還有一項重要限制。

paragraphs.en: At launch, pictures already stored in Google storage
paragraphs.zh: 服務推出時，原本已存於Google儲存空間的相片

paragraphs.en: will not automatically appear in Gallery.
paragraphs.zh: 不會自動顯示在三星相簿中。

paragraphs.en: The service uses existing account capacity
paragraphs.zh: 這項服務使用帳戶既有的儲存容量，

paragraphs.en: rather than providing an additional storage allowance.
paragraphs.zh: 而不會額外提供一份儲存額度。

paragraphs.en: Google's general backup documentation provides useful background.
paragraphs.zh: Google的一般備份說明文件提供了實用的背景資訊。

paragraphs.en: In Google Photos, enabling backup
paragraphs.zh: 在Google相簿中，開啟備份

paragraphs.en: allows photos and videos to be saved automatically.
paragraphs.zh: 就能自動儲存相片和影片。

paragraphs.en: Saved items can be accessed on signed-in devices,
paragraphs.zh: 已儲存的項目可在登入帳戶的裝置上存取，

paragraphs.en: and they remain private unless shared.
paragraphs.zh: 除非主動分享，否則不會公開。

paragraphs.en: Google also explains that the app
paragraphs.zh: Google也說明，這款應用程式

paragraphs.en: can display files stored only on a phone.
paragraphs.zh: 也能顯示僅存於手機上的檔案。

paragraphs.en: Seeing an image there does not prove
paragraphs.zh: 因此，在應用程式裡看見影像，並不能證明

paragraphs.en: that an online copy exists.
paragraphs.zh: 雲端已有副本。

paragraphs.en: A separate Google help page explains
paragraphs.zh: 另一個Google說明頁面指出，

paragraphs.en: that backup settings affect both timing and content.
paragraphs.zh: 備份設定會同時影響備份時間與內容。

paragraphs.en: The selected account and device folders matter,
paragraphs.zh: 選定的帳戶與裝置資料夾都很重要，

paragraphs.en: as does permission to use mobile data.
paragraphs.zh: 是否允許使用行動數據也同樣重要。

paragraphs.en: The status display distinguishes work still in progress
paragraphs.zh: 狀態畫面會區分仍在進行中的備份

paragraphs.en: from a completed backup.
paragraphs.zh: 與已完成的備份。

paragraphs.en: For readers assessing the new partnership,
paragraphs.zh: 對於評估這項新合作的讀者而言，

paragraphs.en: these details highlight the difference
paragraphs.zh: 這些細節凸顯了

paragraphs.en: between turning a feature on and finishing a transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 開啟功能與完成傳輸之間的差別。

paragraphs.en: Capacity is another part of the wider picture.
paragraphs.zh: 儲存容量也是整體情況的一環。

paragraphs.en: Google's storage guidance says
paragraphs.zh: Google的儲存空間說明指出，

paragraphs.en: that running out of account space
paragraphs.zh: 帳戶空間用盡時，

paragraphs.en: prevents further photo and video backups.
paragraphs.zh: 便無法繼續備份相片與影片。

paragraphs.en: It also affects Gmail and Google Drive.
paragraphs.zh: 這也會影響Gmail與Google雲端硬碟。

paragraphs.en: The storage management screen offers a usage summary
paragraphs.zh: 儲存空間管理畫面提供用量摘要，

paragraphs.en: and identifies categories such as large videos.
paragraphs.zh: 並列出大型影片等檔案類別。

paragraphs.en: Free space on a handset
paragraphs.zh: 手機上的可用空間

paragraphs.en: and available account storage are different measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 與帳戶剩餘容量，是兩種不同的衡量數據。

paragraphs.en: The announcement illustrates a broader technology question:
paragraphs.zh: 這份公告帶出了一個更廣泛的科技問題：

paragraphs.en: how can companies make connected services understandable?
paragraphs.zh: 企業如何讓使用者理解彼此連結的服務？

paragraphs.en: Putting online files inside a familiar app
paragraphs.zh: 將雲端檔案放進熟悉的應用程式，

paragraphs.en: may make access feel simpler.
paragraphs.zh: 可能讓存取過程感覺更簡單。

paragraphs.en: Yet clear explanations of availability, storage, and deletion
paragraphs.zh: 然而，清楚說明供應範圍、儲存空間與刪除行為，

paragraphs.en: remain essential for understanding what the system does.
paragraphs.zh: 對理解系統的實際運作仍不可或缺。

paragraphs.en: Convenience depends on clear information
paragraphs.zh: 便利性有賴於清楚的資訊，

paragraphs.en: as well as software integration.
paragraphs.zh: 也有賴於軟體整合。

access.meaning: 存取、取得檔案的功能或能力

account.meaning: 帳戶；文中指Google或三星帳戶

across.meaning: 跨越；文中指跨不同裝置

allowance.meaning: 配額、額度；文中指儲存額度

an.meaning: 一個、一種；母音發音前的不定冠詞

are.meaning: 是；也可作被動語態的助動詞

as.meaning: 如同；as does指…也一樣，such as指例如，as well as指也、以及

at.meaning: 在某時間點；at launch指服務推出時

availability.meaning: 供應或可使用的範圍、情況

collection.meaning: 收藏集；文中指同步後的相片集

deletion.meaning: 刪除的行為或處理方式

item.meaning: 項目；文中指一個相片或影片檔案

large.meaning: 大型的；文中指檔案容量較大的

quiz.question: What is the main purpose of the article?

choices.text: To explain a Galaxy photo service and the conditions that shape its use.
choices.explanation: 正確。文章介紹三星相簿與Google儲存空間的連結，並說明裝置支援、帳戶、同步、刪除及容量等條件。

choices.text: To announce unlimited photo storage for all Samsung customers.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第四段明確表示服務使用既有帳戶容量，並未額外提供儲存額度；第一段也限制支援裝置及市場。

choices.text: To compare the camera quality of new phones and tablets.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。文章討論相片的存取與儲存，沒有比較相機畫質。

choices.text: To argue that online storage should replace every local file.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。文章說明雲端與裝置儲存的差異，沒有主張全面取代本機檔案。

quiz.explanation: 主旨題應涵蓋整篇內容。第一段介紹合作服務，第八段點出使用者還需要理解供應範圍、儲存與刪除行為，因此只有第一個選項同時涵蓋功能與使用條件。

evidence.quote: Samsung described a Gallery service that connects its photo app with Google storage.
Yet clear explanations of availability, storage, and deletion remain essential for understanding what the system does.

quiz.question: What can readers infer about removing photos through Samsung Gallery?

choices.text: Every removal action affects only the phone being used.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。一般刪除已同步項目會影響連結的Google儲存空間及其他已連結裝置。

choices.text: A preview means the original must still occupy space on that device.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第三段指出，可移除裝置上的已同步原始檔並保留小型預覽圖。

choices.text: Removing synchronized local originals and deleting synchronized items have different effects.
choices.explanation: 正確。前者可以保留預覽並釋放裝置空間；後者也會從雲端與其他連結的Galaxy裝置移除項目。

choices.text: Deleting a synchronized item increases the account storage allowance.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。刪除可能改變使用量，但文章沒有說會提高帳戶的儲存額度；第四段指出服務不額外提供額度。

quiz.explanation: 第三段區分兩種動作：移除裝置內已同步的原始檔，仍可保留預覽；在相簿刪除已同步項目，則會影響連結的雲端及其他裝置。不能把這兩種動作視為相同。

evidence.quote: Samsung also offers a feature that removes synchronized originals from a device while keeping small preview images visible. However, deleting a synchronized item in Gallery also removes it from linked Google storage and other connected Galaxy devices.

quiz.question: Why might seeing a photo in Google Photos be insufficient evidence that it has been backed up online?

choices.text: The app always hides photos after a backup finishes.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。文章沒有說備份完成後會隱藏相片；第六段說可用狀態畫面區分備份是否完成。

choices.text: The app may show a local file, and a transfer may still be unfinished.
choices.explanation: 正確。第五段說應用程式可能顯示僅存於手機的檔案，第六段則指出開啟備份與完成傳輸不同。

choices.text: The service requires every photo to be shared publicly before backup.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第五段指出，已儲存項目除非分享，否則保持不公開，並無先公開才能備份的要求。

choices.text: An image can be backed up only after the phone has no free space.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。文中沒有這項條件；第七段反而指出帳戶空間用盡會阻止後續備份。

quiz.explanation: 要結合第五與第六段推論：相片出現在應用程式中，可能只是本機檔案；即使已開啟備份，也不代表傳輸完成。因此，單靠看見相片不足以確認雲端副本存在。

evidence.quote: Google also explains that the app can display files stored only on a phone. Seeing an image there does not prove that an online copy exists.
The status display distinguishes work still in progress from a completed backup.
